ios.desc:
ExpenseJar: Your Personal Finance Companion

Take control of your finances with ExpenseJar—the ultimate personal finance app that makes expense tracking, budgeting, and financial planning simple and intuitive.

KEY FEATURES:
Quick Expense Recording – Log transactions in seconds with smart category suggestions.
Budget Management – Set and monitor budgets for different spending categories.
Smart Analytics – Visualize spending patterns with insightful charts and reports.
Home Screen Widget – Add an app widget to your home screen for quick access and better visibility.
Bank Statement Import – Easily import your bank statements with a single click for effortless tracking.
Daily Reminders – Get notified to log your expenses and stay on track.
Secure Data – Your financial data is encrypted and securely stored.
Cloud Sync – Seamlessly access your data across all your devices.
Export Options – Export financial data for better analysis.
Dark Mode Support – Enjoy a comfortable viewing experience in any lighting condition.

DETAILED TRACKING:
Categorize Expenses Automatically – Smart categorization saves you time.
Add Notes to Transactions – Keep additional context for every expense.
View Daily, Weekly & Monthly Summaries – Get a complete overview of your finances.
Filter & Search Transactions – Quickly find what you need with advanced search.

BUDGET FEATURES:
Set & Track Budgets – Create category-specific or overall budgets.
Get Budget Alerts – Avoid overspending with real-time notifications.
Visual Budget Tracking – Monitor your budget with clear visual indicators.
Flexible Adjustments – Modify budgets as needed based on your spending.

ANALYTICS & INSIGHTS:
Spending Trends Over Time – Understand how your habits evolve.
Category-Based Expense Analysis – See where your money is going.
Compare Monthly Spending – Gain insights into financial habits.
Identify Savings Opportunities – Discover ways to cut costs and save more.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
User Profile Management – Personalize your profile for a tailored experience.
Comprehensive Expense Tracking – Log income and expenses easily.
Customizable Categories – Manage and personalize categories effortlessly.
Support & Help Center – Get answers and assistance when needed.
Customizable Themes – Choose themes that match your style.

SECURITY & PRIVACY:
Secure Login – Keep your data safe with strong authentication.
End-to-End Encryption – Your information remains private and protected.

quotes.text:
I built ExpenseJar after getting frustrated with existing budgeting apps that were either too bloated or too limited. I wanted something fast, simple, and focused purely on helping users track spending and stick to budgets — without unnecessary complexity or ads.

Key features:

Fast manual expense entry with smart suggestions

One-click bank statement import (CSV/PDF parsing)

Budget tracking with alerts

Daily reminders to stay consistent

Encrypted cloud sync across devices

Minimal UI with dark mode support

No account linking required

It’s available on iOS:
 https://apps.apple.com/us/app/expensejar-track-budget/id6739467259

Would love feedback, bug reports, or suggestions from fellow HNers. Happy to answer any technical/product questions!
